boundary: The guard set and response grammar are unchanged; this execution variant keys memoization by exact RBA words packed into a collision-free BigInt plus the neutral-aware guard mask and horizon.
Raw physical ownership is used only to recognize newly neutral occupied cells; it is not part of memo identity.
An occupied odd-row ownership bit is promoted to gray only when that cell belongs to no still-possible winning line for either player.
Neutrality is monotone under token addition, so a promoted gray ownership distinction is never required again.
No new response type is introduced: all candidates belong to previously frozen CPC response, guard-renewal, support-lift, or top-debt theorems.
Top-debt repair retains the existing premise that at least one carried guard survives trigger and response untouched.
Acceptance is a constructive survival lower certificate only; rejection is not an attacker upper bound.
